    public static int Repeats(List<int> nums) {

        var uniqueCounts = nums.GroupBy(x => x)

            .Select(x => new { Element = x.Element, Count = x.Element * n }); // Multiply by n (1 for this problem, 2 for the next).

        foreach (var item in uniqueCounts) {
            n += item.Element;
        }

        return n;
    }
}
